dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: Yes, and you want to know why? It's because there's this researcher from Sumeru running around spreading false histories!

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: I don't know what school of reasoning he's from, but whatever it is, he's just spinning out fantasies and distortions!

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: He doesn't seem all that fond of verifying anything, but oh, he's very fascinated with non-existent hypotheses and stories, that's for sure! He's giving me a real headache...

dialogues.speaker: Mochizuki
dialogues.text: I only hope that people aren't taken in by his words and forget Sangonomiya Shrine's real history...
